Founder, Mindleaf

"


João Doria Neto

Founder, Squad

### Real problems from real people

Agents search online communities and surface genuine pain points people actually experience.

### Evidence over speculation

Every idea is grounded in what real people said they struggle with. Read their words and see the context.

### Guided evaluation

Your AI cofounder helps you assess which problems are most promising and worth pursuing.

## Ultraplan

### Find your biggest blocker

A dedicated planning agent assesses your entire project and identifies the single constraint limiting progress.

### Actionable tasks

Your AI cofounder creates a plan and works through each task with you, step by step.

### Adapts as you grow

Replans from scratch at each inflection point so your plan always reflects reality.

"

I used to use ChatGPT to build, research and inspire... But this is next level; answers are much better, connected to Reddit, it is really well organized and structured, it is guided, it leads the conversation, not me.

"


Pablo Junquera

Founder, BreadCrumbs

"

Honestly, incredible. I've just got my next start up venture idea now and it's been easily validated - all via your platform. That's where I've failed in the past - I build things without validation first.

"


Vicky Rai

Founder, Rai Tech Solutions

## Research

### Parallel AI agents

Multiple agents research simultaneously, each going deep on a specific area of your question.

### Cited reports

Every claim links back to its source so you can verify and trust the findings.

### Comprehensive coverage

From competitor analysis to regulatory landscapes. Get the thorough research complex questions deserve.

## "5 stars doesn’t do justice to an app that fundamentally improved my business direction"


### Filipe Prado

Founder, Aillustra
